# Approve a project's onboarding `ONB`

[As built](../README.md) › Approve a project's onboarding

As built at `4b8570d19ee1`, read 2026-10-07.

Lets a user review what Fabrika proposed after reading a repository -- checks, guides, recommendations, gates -- decide which to adopt, decline or reinstate, and approve the project so builds can run. Built on export:ProjectOnboarding and the gate-0 routes.
